graph.title: Product development lifecycle
graph.subtitle: A continuous loop: what we learn from each release feeds the next round of discovery.

nodes.label: Define
nodes.note: Frame the problem, goals and success metrics.

nodes.label: Design
nodes.note: Explore solutions, prototype and test with users.

nodes.label: Build
nodes.note: Engineer, test and harden the solution.

nodes.label: Launch
nodes.note: Release to customers and support adoption.

nodes.label: Measure
nodes.note: Track usage, outcomes and the success metrics.

nodes.label: Learn
nodes.note: Turn results into insights for the next cycle.

nodes.label: Customer value
nodes.note: Every stage serves the same goal.
